Great new benchmark to test agents on everyday work. 

I like that you can use it to test an agent's reliability across multiple attempts. 

Tested on 12 models. Cool to see open-source harnesses show competitiveness.
posts.quoted: The best AI agents still fail about 4 in 10 everyday tasks. ShellBench, out today: 100 real-world tasks, 12 models, 5 harnesses, 53,100 graded runs. Top score: 62.5%. Passing all three attempts: 48.8%. Open-source harnesses held their own. https:// openclaw.ai/blog/shellbench
